definitions.explanation: A word that has the same or nearly the same meaning as another word. A standard linguistics and language-learning term.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{類義語|るいぎご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{巨大|きょだい}→巨大：02586_kyodai⟧」です。
{類義語|るいぎご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い{分|わ}け→使い分け：11559_tsukaiwake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。

⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{類義語|るいぎご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べて→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧、⟦{微妙|びみょう}→微妙：03589_bimyou⟧な⟦ニュアンス→ニュアンス：11138_nyuansu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}した→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧。
examples.english: I looked up synonyms in the dictionary and understood the subtle differences in nuance.

notes:
USAGE:
{類義語|るいぎご} is the standard term used in language education and linguistics. It appears frequently in textbooks, dictionaries, and language exams.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {類義語|るいぎご}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧ (thesaurus, synonym dictionary)
- {類義語|るいぎご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い{分|わ}け→使い分け：11559_tsukaiwake⟧ (distinguishing between synonyms)
- {類義語|るいぎご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧ (to look up synonyms)

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{対義語|たいぎご}→対義語：29399_taigigo⟧ means antonym. ⟦{同義語|どうぎご}→同義語：26263_dougigo⟧ means a word with exactly the same meaning, while {類義語|るいぎご} includes words with similar but not identical meanings.
